title: Can outpatient Occupational Therapy services be availed at Pinnacle for children with autism?
metaTitle: Outpatient Occupational Therapy for Children with Autism - Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Learn more about the outpatient Occupational Therapy services we offer at Pinnacle Blooms Network. We customize therapy plans to cater to the unique needs and progress goals of each child.
html: Absolutely, at Pinnacle Blooms Network, we are dedicated to making our services as accessible as possible, which includes offering outpatient Occupational Therapy services. Your child's therapy plan, including frequency and duration, will be customized according to their unique needs and progress goals.
